_meta.light_dark_relationship: LIGHT/DARK IRRELEVANT: no typography token is redefined in .dark, @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark), or any media query. Every value below has exactly one definition in the whole stylesheet (verified by counting duplicate token definitions).
_meta.no_webfont_files: No brand/custom font binaries in the snapshot. All .woff2/.woff/.ttf files in assets/ are KaTeX (math rendering) only. The UI runs entirely on system font stacks.

sans.value: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"
sans.notes: Generic-only stack. Contains NO CJK family -> Chinese glyphs fall through to the browser/OS default CJK font (Windows: Microsoft YaHei; macOS: PingFang SC; Android: Noto Sans CJK / Source Han Sans). Compose must supply a CJK-capable fallback explicitly.

mono.value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", "Microsoft YaHei UI", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", monospace
mono.notes: Unlike --font-sans, the mono stack explicitly appends CJK families (Microsoft YaHei UI / Microsoft YaHei / PingFang SC / Noto Sans CJK SC) before the generic `monospace`. So CJK inside code blocks/terminal renders in a CJK proportional-ish font, not a monospaced CJK font. This is intentional in the source and affects code-block Chinese rendering.

default_font_family.applied_to: html,:host via Tailwind preflight `html,:host{font-family:var(--default-font-family,ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, ...)}`

body_effective_override.source: index.html inline <style> `body{ ... font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }` (lines 122-127)
body_effective_override.precedence: The inline <style> is in <head> BEFORE the stylesheet <link> (index.html line 253), but it targets `body` directly, whereas the app CSS sets the family on `html`. A direct body declaration beats inheritance from html, so THIS is the effective font-family for the app body.
body_effective_override.inter_note: No @font-face for Inter and no Inter font file exists in the snapshot -> 'Inter' only resolves if the OS has it installed; otherwise the stack falls back to the platform UI font.
body_effective_override.role: bootstrap / first-paint font stack; also the effective runtime stack unless a component re-applies font-sans/font-mono

math.notes: Only used by KaTeX math rendering. Not part of the general UI typography. Compose side: use a math renderer (e.g. a KaTeX-equivalent) or ignore unless math output must be 1:1.

font_size._note: Tailwind v4 default scale. `value` = rem, `px` = rem*16, `line_height` = the paired --text-*--line-height (unitless ratio) and `line_height_px` = ratio*font px. Source for all: index-BD2BL4Cc.css @layer theme :root,:host.

5xl_and_above.notes: Not emitted in the stylesheet -> not used by the UI. Tailwind defaults would be 5xl=3rem, 6xl=3.75rem, 7xl=4.5rem, 8xl=6rem, 9xl=8rem.

font_size_ui_scale._note: App-specific responsive UI scale. All values are calc() off --ui-font-size. Defined in the @layer theme :root,:host block. These have NO paired line-height variable -> line-height is inherited (html line-height:1.5). Source: index-BD2BL4Cc.css.

base_variable.name: --ui-font-size
base_variable.conditional_variants: NONE — declared exactly once in the whole stylesheet (no media-query / dark / density override).

mobile-input-safe.purpose: iOS zoom-prevention size for mobile input fields.

font_size_arbitrary_oneoffs._note: Hard-coded px font sizes found in the stylesheet (arbitrary Tailwind values / component CSS). Listed for completeness; NOT a scale.

v4-draft-greeting-font-size.reason: Referenced by the utility above but NEVER defined in CSS -> set at runtime as an inline style by React. Not recoverable from the static snapshot.

font_weight._note: Source: index-BD2BL4Cc.css @layer theme :root,:host. Only these four weights are emitted; all other Tailwind weight steps are unused.

unused_tailwind_steps.notes: No --font-weight-* var emitted for these, but raw `font-weight:300/800/900` literals DO appear in component CSS (font-weight:300 x1, 800 x2, 900 x1) and `bolder` x2. Treat as one-off component overrides.

raw_declaration_histogram._note: index-BD2BL4Cc.css raw `font-weight:` values, count of rules

normal.base: Also the preflight default on html,:host -> `html,:host{line-height:1.5}`

wf-label.note: App-specific token (workflow labels), not a Tailwind default.

raw_one_off_values._note: index-BD2BL4Cc.css raw `letter-spacing:` values that are NOT the tokens above

html.declared_vars: NONE — --default-font-feature-settings / --default-font-variation-settings are never defined, so the effective value is `normal`.

tabular_numbers.notes: Tailwind's tabular-nums exists; --tw-numeric-spacing is set to `tabular-nums` when the class is applied. Used for aligned numeric columns (usage stats/tables).

code_and_monospace._note: Everything relevant to code blocks / inline code / terminal in the conversation UI.

base_size.effective_px: Depends on the ancestor's font-size (1em = inherit). In practice ancestors use --text-ui-* or the Tailwind scale, so code renders at the SAME size as surrounding text unless a wrapper overrides it.
base_size.compose_implication: Do not hard-code a code font size; inherit the body/paragraph size.

code_and_monospace.font_size_overrides_found: UNKNOWN for a dedicated code-block size — no `--text-code`-style token exists and no rule was found that sets a distinct font-size on a code-block/pre wrapper.
code_and_monospace.features: font-feature-settings: normal, font-variation-settings: normal (no ligatures enabled, no monospace-specific features)
code_and_monospace.pre_whitespace: index-BD2BL4Cc.css `pre{white-space:pre}` (Tailwind preflight keeps `pre` non-wrapping) — horizontal scroll is expected in code blocks.

inline_code.notes: Colors are owned by the color subagent; only noting the token exists so the Compose inline-code chip can be wired to the same variable.

terminal_xterm.reason: xterm.js sets its font via JS options (fontFamily/fontSize). No `fontFamily`/`fontSize` literal was found in the JS bundles in this snapshot (the terminal font is almost certainly injected from server/runtime config or a settings object), and no CSS rule sets a font on .xterm elements.
terminal_xterm.css_found: .xterm rules exist in index-BD2BL4Cc.css but none declare font-family or font-size.
terminal_xterm.compose_implication: Use --font-mono at the same size as the surrounding UI (or expose it as a user setting) — the snapshot gives no fixed terminal font size.

math_katex.font_size: KaTeX drives its own sizing relative to its container; no app-level token.

cjk_notes.sans_cjk_resolution: OS/browser default CJK font (Windows: Microsoft YaHei / Microsoft YaHei UI; macOS: PingFang SC; Android: Noto Sans CJK SC or OEM equivalent).
cjk_notes.compose_recommendation: For 1:1 rendering on Android, define the sans fallback as e.g. 'Noto Sans SC' / system CJK and the mono fallback as the CJK families listed in --font-mono so Chinese glyphs inside code blocks match the web behaviour.
